assessments.reasoning: Evaluating each element: 1) de_jure_vs_de_facto: False. While marital status (Q16) and relationship to household head (Q5) are collected, the instrument lacks questions on migration, external income, or remittances, making it impossible to distinguish de jure from de facto female-headed households. 2) unpartnered_mother_child_units: False. Relationship in Q5 is recorded strictly relative to the household head ('jefa o jefe del hogar'), preventing the explicit identification of mother-child sub-units within extended or complex households. 3) women_maintained_by_provider: False. The instrument collects individual labor income in Section 2 Part C (Q37), but does not capture non-labor income, transfers, or identify the household's main economic provider overall. 4) mother_child_unit_activity: False. The questionnaire contains no items measuring consumption, production, or care activities disaggregated at the mother-child sub-unit ('hearth-hold') level.
